verdict.rationale: GitHub notes an 'interactive playground to test and generate request code' (crawl4ai-gh-26) and docs show runnable code snippets (crawl4ai-docs-1/8), suggesting some interactive example capability, but there is no evidence of a full interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI UI) — probes explicitly show openapi.json/swagger.json 404s (crawl4ai-probe-2). Missing for 10: dedicated interactive API reference page, OpenAPI/Swagger-based docs, independent confirmation of the playground's scope and runnable examples beyond a single claim.
